title: Platformer
description: Pixel art at 16 texels a tile is printed on paper cards under a desk lamp. Each card casts a soft shadow on the cards behind it, and its cut edges catch the light. Each layer is drawn at 16 texels a tile on its own grid, and the print composites the layers at full resolution, moving each by whole screen pixels so they scroll smoothly without breaking up their texels. Sprites are drawn at full resolution too, each placed on whole screen pixels with a 16-texel grid of its own, so they glide at any refresh rate. Hero physics runs on the CPU at 120 Hz. The GPU moves critters, counts their contacts as events and reads them back. A coroutine removes collected coins from a table. Particles add dust and sparkles.
line: Pixel art printed on paper cards, critters moved on the GPU.
hint: arrows or A D move · space jumps, longer when held
